homePanels.title: 苏云雷 Ray
homePanels.subtitle: 非典型理工博士生 · 《待会儿再说》节目主持人
homePanels.subtitleEn: Unconventional STEM PhD Student · Host of "Talk Later"
paragraphs: 本科毕业于安徽大学地理信息科学专业，硕士就读于新加坡国立大学（NUS）应用地理信息系统专业，目前在香港科技大学（广州）攻读博士学位；也是独立产品「阿薄」作者，以及小宇宙播客《待会儿再说》节目主持人。
Welcome to My World, My Lord, and My Lady.
我的朋友，我希望我们的友谊长久；如果与您初识，希望我们可以成为朋友。
这里既记录我的学术探索，也收藏独立开发、播客对谈与生活影像。
paragraphsEn: BSc in GIS from Anhui University, MSc in Applied GIS from the National University of Singapore (NUS), and currently a PhD student at HKUST(GZ). Also an indie product builder (BOJI) and host of the Xiaoyuzhou podcast "Talk Later" (《待会儿再说》).
Welcome to My World, My Lord, and My Lady.
Whether we are old friends or meeting for the first time, I hope our conversations and friendships last.
This space brings together my academic publications, engineering builds, podcast talks, and moments from daily life.

homePanels.title: 学术成果
homePanels.subtitle: WebGIS · 城市数字孪生 · 人-建筑交互
homePanels.subtitleEn: WebGIS · Urban Digital Twins · Human-Building Interaction
paragraphs: 研究围绕城市数字孪生（Urban Digital Twins）、人-建筑交互（Human-Building Interaction）、VR 城市建模与眼动感知、以及多模态大语言模型驱动的城市建筑语义表征展开。
已同步收录 Google Scholar 上的 7 篇期刊与国际会议论文（涵盖 JAG、Cities、3D GeoInfo Best Paper Award、SpatialDI、CUPUM 与 E3S），附带 DOI、BibTeX 与开源代码链接。
paragraphsEn: My research focuses on Urban Digital Twins, Human-Building Interaction, VR city modeling and eye-tracking perception, and multimodal LLM-powered urban building characterization.

Includes all 7 peer-reviewed journal and conference publications synced from Google Scholar (JAG, Cities, 3D GeoInfo Best Paper Award, SpatialDI, CUPUM, and E3S) with DOI, BibTeX, and open-source links.

homePanels.title: 艺术篇章
homePanels.subtitle: Life is full of Art
paragraphs: 时间流逝得太快，许多事都记不清了。
谨以此篇记录那些叫做回忆的东西——朋友、球场、杭州与母校岁月。
paragraphsEn: Time moves so fast that details easily fade away.
This collection preserves the memories worth keeping — friends, basketball courts, Hangzhou, and campus years at AHU.

homePanels.title: 实践与播客
homePanels.subtitle: 产品 · 空间工程 · 《待会儿再说》
paragraphs: 既有独立全栈健康产品「阿薄（BOJI）」、Urban Morphology Studio (UMS) 课题组官网、WebGIS 与企业前端工程实践，也有我和朋友们在小宇宙一起成长的播客节目《待会儿再说》。
paragraphsEn: Featuring the full-stack indie AI wellness product BOJI (阿薄), the Urban Morphology Studio (UMS) research group website, WebGIS and enterprise web engineering projects, and our Xiaoyuzhou podcast "Talk Later" (《待会儿再说》).

homePanels.title: 联系我
homePanels.subtitle: Let us begin our story
paragraphs: 可能我们许久未联系了，老朋友。
可能我们初次相识，新朋友。
可能我们仍未相识，陌生人。欢迎随时来信交流学术问题、产品合作、播客串台或生活近况。
paragraphsEn: Perhaps we haven't caught up in a while, old friend.
Perhaps we are meeting for the first time, or haven't crossed paths yet.
Feel free to reach out about research collaborations, indie products, podcast conversations, or just to say hello.
